description: This file contains client-side API functions for interacting with a backend service, notably functions to identify user identities via image uploads, fetch results, and establish WebSocket communication. It includes error handling, environment configuration, and mock data for testing.

methods.name: sleep(ms)
methods.description: Asynchronous delay function that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: apiBase()
methods.description: Constructs the API base URL, removing any trailing slashes.

methods.name: friendlyNetworkError(originalError, url)
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message based on network error details.

methods.name: findIdentities(file, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Uploads an image to the identification API or mocks a response during testing, and returns the identification status and results.

methods.name: getResults(requestId, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Polls the backend for identification results based on a request ID.

methods.name: connectWS(onMessage)
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection if a URL is provided, handling incoming messages.

methods.name: normalizeResults(data)
methods.description: Converts backend data into a normalized array of profile results.

methods.name: mockResults()
methods.description: Provides mock profile data for testing purposes.

ctags.name: sleep
ctags.pattern: /^function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }$/
